body:
# ⚔ SpearTop

A competitive **spear kill leaderboard** plugin for Paper servers.
Top 3 players earn exclusive rank spears with powerful enchantments!

---

## 🏆 Features

- Kill players with a spear → climb the leaderboard
- Top 3 earn a **rank spear** with exclusive enchantments
- Lose your rank → spear is **automatically removed**
- Rank spears are **unbreakable** and **kept on death**

---

## 🗡 Ranks

| Rank | Spear | Enchantments |
|------|-------|-------------|
| 🥇 Top 1 | Netherite Spear | Sharpness V, Mending, Fire Aspect II, Looting III, Knockback II, Lunge III |
| 🥈 Top 2 | Diamond Spear | Sharpness IV, Fire Aspect II, Looting II, Knockback I, Lunge III |
| 🥉 Top 3 | Golden Spear | Sharpness III, Fire Aspect I, Knockback I, Lunge III |

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/speartop` | Show the leaderboard |
| `/myspear` | Claim your rank spear |
| `/speartop reload` | Reload config (OP only) |

---

## ⚙ Config

- Enchantment levels per rank
- Custom item plugin support (ItemsAdder, Oraxen, etc.)
- Leaderboard size & messages

---

## 📌 Requirements

- Paper 1.21 — 1.21.11
- Java 21+

---
